warning.titlePre: Mercedes G63 AMG M157 Valve Seal & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: If your G63 AMG is a 2012-2018 W463-generation model with the M157 twin-turbo V8, valve seal and coolant system wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine. We replace valve seals, timing chains, coolant components and bearings as standard on every M157 rebuild - the same pattern confirmed across the AMG V8 family in the S-Class, CLS and E-Class.

The current-generation G63 AMG (2018-present, W463a) uses a different engine, the M177 4.0-litre V8 - a later design with its own valve seal and coolant wear pattern, but not the same unit as the M157 fitted to your 2012-2018 car.
warning.source: Source: established AMG specialist pattern, confirmed across the Mercedes G-BRF's AMG V8 family. M177 explicitly excluded from this M157-specific claim per VRF, correctly scoped to generation
